title: The Nykaa lipstick
premise: Daughter claims she never bought the new lipstick; Mummy says it arrived in her name so she already tested the shade and it suits her better.

script.text: Why is the lipstick called Brick Red Rebel.
It is mine now. Order another one.

caption: nykaa parcel

post.caption: Brick Red Rebel looks better on her anyway. Send this to your mumma.
